title: Healing Courses in Bali Yoga School
intro: Become a Himalayan Yoga Association Society certified professional healer at Bali Yoga School. We have 3 levels of Sound Healing Courses, 3 Levels of Reiki Healing Courses, and 2 Ayurveda Courses.
During our healing courses in Bali, you will also have daily yoga class (ex. Hatha vinyasa / Meditation) to enhance your experiences.
